- [Ops Manager - (current) (Part 5 of 5)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ops-manager/current/ops-manager-5-llms.txt.md): > This part of the Ops Manager documentation covers release notes and changelogs, plus step-by-step tutorials for automation, backups, and monitoring.
